description: Capability for the main window, the region-capture overlay, the annotation editor and the post-capture preview. `allow-destroy` is load-bearing: the editor registers a JS tauri://close-requested listener, which makes Tauri prevent the native close and hand the decision to the webview — @tauri-apps/api's onCloseRequested then calls destroy() itself for every event it is not told to prevent. Without the permission the editor's title-bar X silently does nothing. `preview` is listed for the same reason every window is: a label in no capability is granted nothing, so `listen('preview://show')` would be denied and the preview would sit on screen blank until its orphan timeout took it down.
